flipChip.quote: The new generation of CAPRA features a Flip Chip on both the MX and 29 builds, to allow you to adjust the geometry according to the terrain and your riding style. The Flip Chip eyelet can now be found on the shock yoke. The low position provides for a more aggressive headtube angle and lowers the BB, ideal for fast tracks. In the high position, the headtube angle is 0.3 degrees steeper and the BB is higher for more ground clearance and better performance on steep climbs.
flipChip.where: Frame feature 'FLIP CHIP'; geometry table has 'Flip Chip Position high/low' (HTA 64,2° / 64,5°, BB drop 27 / 22 mm)
